program.name: Twist & Brace
program.subject: Core & abs
program.blurb: Obliques and anti-rotation: windshield wipers, side plank dips, halos and carries.
program.about: The sides of the core: obliques that rotate, and deep muscles that resist rotation. One day twists with windshield wipers, heel taps and side plank dips, the other resists with carries, halos and plank reaches. Straight sets with an abs finisher. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up where there is a weight. Good for any sport that swings or throws.
